description.value: Skeena Bakery is an artisan bakery and coffee shop in New Hazelton, operated by the not-for-profit Skeena Supported Employment Society, which provides supported employment and training for people with disabilities in the Hazeltons. The bakery turns out an extensive range of handmade breads — sourdough, dark rye, spelt, and more — using organic ingredients, alongside sweet treats and savouries served with locally roasted Mercedes Beans coffee in its shop-front cafe. It supplies both retail customers and wholesale accounts across northwest BC, making it a genuine community anchor on the Highway 16 corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms Skeena Bakery as a real, operating artisan bakery and coffee shop in New Hazelton. The website lists the address as '4477 Highway 16' while OSM records '4477 10th Avenue', a discrepancy flagged below; the postcode V0J 2J0 matches. Phone and email are present on the contact page but absent from OSM tags. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water) are mentioned anywhere on the site, though the coffee shop component provides confirmed hot drinks and savouries.
concerns: Address discrepancy: OSM records '4477 10th Avenue' but the website consistently states '4477 Highway 16, New Hazelton'. These may refer to the same physical location (Highway 16 may carry a local street name in this block), but should be verified.
Phone number (250) 842-0010 and email skeenabakery@gmail.com found on website but absent from OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating artisan bakery and cafe on the Highway 16 corridor; a useful food and coffee stop for touring cyclists passing through the Hazeltons.
